reviews.text: Mochi had his gallbladder removed at San Diego Bay Animal Hospital, and I couldn’t have asked for a better team to take care of him. His doctors were thorough and kept me informed, and the techs were so patient and gentle with him. They made a really scary situation much easier, and I’m so thankful for the care they gave Mochi.

Dr. Sebastian & the team were incredibly kind, patient, and educational when it came time for my cat to cross the rainbow bridge. They exhausted every diagnosis and walked me through every single step while giving me space to grieve and support throughout the procedure. She was loved, in a temple of blankets, and purred until the end and I’ll never forget her or the relief the team helped me find. Thank you forever ❤️

This review is LONG overdue.  Found this incredible team of fur baby subject matter experts when Banfield caused my senior cat to perish, due to malpractice - I will never go back.  Dr. Luecking and her team are the best.  My 2 rescue cats are thriving thanks to this incredible group of canine/feline health care professionals.  RIP Bonnie.  :)  Love, Jynx and Mochi

DO NOT TAKE YOUR PET HERE. STAY AWAY!!!!
I would give a 0 star if I could.

This was one of the worst experiences I’ve ever had with a vet. I brought my dog in for an ear infection and somehow ended up paying almost $1,000 after they ran a bunch of tests. In the end, I walked out with a small bottle of medicine. The doctor even told me the problem could keep coming back, so I would probably have to come back again for more medicine.

A few weeks later, I came back because the medicine was finished and my dog needed another prescription. That’s when things got really bad.

They took my dog to the back without me, which I found extremely strange and was not comfortable with at all. I wanted to be there with my own dog, but they took him away from me anyway.

Then they started pushing more tests and more charges. I told them I did not want all these extra tests, but they kept trying to convince me. It felt like they were looking for every possible way to charge me more money.

The staff was extremely rude and disrespectful. I did not feel listened to, respected, or like they actually cared about helping my dog. I felt like all they saw was a way to make more money.

I already spent almost $1,000 the first time, and instead of simply helping with the same problem they already diagnosed, they immediately wanted to do more tests and charge me again.

This place feels like a complete money grab. I would never trust them with my dog again, and I would never recommend them to anyone.

I am taking this seriously and plan to report my experience to the California Veterinary Medical Board and BBB to make sure other pet owners know exactly what happened to me so they don’t go through the same and do not get fooled by these money hungry profiteers.

PLEASE DO YOUR RESEARCH BEFORE BRINGING YOUR PET HERE. I WISH I HAD.

Super friendly staff and I had a really good experience :)

Hours saved me as I got off work at 5pm and almost everything else was closed.
We really appreciate the rating! We're here to be the best in veterinary care and are glad you had a great experience with us.

My vet closed recently so I was looking for a new vet. They popped up online and I signed up for an appointment. I get a call literally 5 minutes later saying I need to make a deposit $25 for the appointment. How tacky. I’ve never done that for my vet. Even My personal physician. Super random to make a vet appointment and have them calling for cash immediately after. I’m not going to give my business to people who are more interested in my money than my animal. They didn’t ask one question about my dog. Just wham bam give us your money! Pass.
The entire staff cares about the pets and their well being. They understand the stress that the owners sometimes are going through. Thank you

The staff was zero energy and not very kind. We expressed to them early on that our dog was reactive and we didn’t feel comfortable weighing him next to another dog because of this. The vet tech looked at him and us , and said well I still need a weight. Turned around then asked the owner behind her to just move to a different side … why is there not a separate weigh station in a private room? We finally get into the room and after a very traumatizing vet check with the doctor. Nothing was cleared up, we left the vet with only more concerns. She didn’t really give us any direct answers. Said we’d need an xray to rule out any scary stuff (that’d be a 350 charge plus 222 for a radiologist to review) and then said even that wouldn’t be read to give a definitive  answer . That we’d need an MRI to be truly sure. After our dachshund was assessed (which was also not fun for him) he then got a blood draw (that we had to do for meds… $200 dollars again.) scam . And then a shot . We sat in the waiting room for another 30 plus minutes with zero communication while my dog sat with me shaking and upset. Traumatized. The staff here is not empathetic towards animals and truly looking to foot you the biggest bill they can .
Thank you for the wonderful rating! We certainly appreciate your trust. We're here to deliver quality veterinary care whenever you need us.

I showed up a day early for my scheduled appointment. My mistake, but they took care of me anyway, and gave my dog his shots. I have been going to this vet for five years. I would not consider changing. I think they’re great.

We have been coming here for over 3 years and they are pretty good and consistent with their care! The only thing that gets me every time is that we will be in an appointment for either 40 min or 2 hrs, there’s really no in between. Sometimes I get pulled back right away and everything is smooth, other times like today I am in the waiting room 25 min after my appointment time and then waiting again in the exam room. Just some better time management and expectations would make this great! Even just telling me an expected wait time up front.

We had the best veterinary experience we’ve ever had with Dr. Luecking. This was largely also in part to her awesome vet assistant, Bre. I felt well informed of all my options while not pressured. They were awesome about making sure to clearly explain all costs before doing any treatments and gave us a complimentary nail trim while my cat was sedated. We will be using them for all of our pets moving forward.
Had a wonderful experience, it was my first visit and will definitely be bringing all my animals here.

Attentive, fast and courteous. Dr. Herr is amazing, and the staff are wonderful and care. They are also great with following up. They saved our 9 year old diabetic cat when he went in to DKA and had him transferred to VSH in a timely manner. Highly recommend!
Thank you for the wonderful rating! We take a lot of pride in delivering the best care and are glad you had a great experience with us.

DONT GO HERE. This place doesn't have doctors during regular business hours. They said they couldn't help us when our cat lightly injured her tail...YET claim to be able to do emergency surgeries.
Go to VEG ER for Pets. Great staff, excellent triage, resonable prices and very compassionate.

I’ve been coming here for my pup, Lexi, for years now and I’ve loved all the interaction I’ve had. The lobby is welcoming and spacious to give space for other furry family members and they even have a self-serve coffee stand. The front desk staff are always so kind and helpful. In the back of the office, the technicians and doctors are also just as great! Techs get everything prepped before the doc comes in and then the doctor goes over all the recommendations. There’s so much financial help that the options ease any concern that you might have. I highly recommend coming here for whatever little, or big, family member of yours.

I took my dog to have an annual wellness exam and update vaccines, and was my first visit with San Diego Bay Animal Hospital.

The staff was very attentive, friendly, and clearly cared about creating a positive experience for me and my pet. The wellness exam went smoothly, the vaccinations were great, and we left feeling really good about our experience.

Dr. Espinosa was very friendly, informative, and cared about my animal's well being which is all you can ask for. Would recommend!

The pricing was very fair and made in good faith with total approval needed ahead before any work took place. The office and exam rooms were clean.

It can be hard to find a vet that you really like, but after this first visit, we will definitely be back for any future needs.

Transfered Vet care to this facility and I was very impressed by the staff,  the Doc and the Vet Techs, they took great care of my Dog it felt like we have befn coming to this facility for awhile ,  the way this clinic is run I truly feel happy I picked this place for my dog's care.  I recommend it .

My dog has been a patient at Mission Bay Animal Hospital for 7 months. He was a rescue puppy from Mexico and was severely dehydrated. I spent upward of $2000.00 for two days of hydration (8 hours a day). He made it and now is a 7 month old growing Weimaraner. He has hot spots currently and called them to make an appointment and they have a new policy where they charge $98.00 as a deposit for the appointment. We are NOT a new client - I can understand that policy for new clients but for old clients (pre policy) - that’s ridiculous. They are on the high side for a Vet office but I overlooked that because of the care they gave our puppy. For me, it gives money first, care last, and zero concern for the patient/owner relationship. There are excellent vets in San Diego and I would never prepay an appointment with any doctor that I’ve established care with - especially if I’ve already paid out a significant amount in the past. It’s a bad policy and they have lost a client.

I had a very disappointing experience at San Diego Bay Animal Hospital and would not recommend it. When I first brought my dog in, I was told the checkup would be $25. However, additional charges were added without much clarity, including anxiety medication for my dog that did not work at all.
On my second visit, I was told they would need to increase the dosage of the anxiety medication. When they took my dog to the back to draw blood, I could hear her screaming bloody murder, which was extremely upsetting. When she was brought back out, I was told she needed even more anxiety medication. Despite me providing both stool and urine samples, they ended up throwing them away and said they couldn’t be used because they were unable to draw her blood.
The staff came across as very dismissive and cold throughout both visits, and I never felt like my concerns were taken seriously. On top of the emotional stress, they continued trying to charge me more for additional services after I had already spent a significant amount of money.
I only went to this hospital twice, but both visits left me feeling sad, frustrated, and uncomfortable with the care my dog received. Based on my experience, I would not return or recommend this place to other pet owners.

This environment was clean and welcoming. The staff was friendly and professional. My dog was nervous and they were very gentle with her. She was treated for allergies which was a shot of cytopoint antibiotic and a wash for her wounds. We did also take a recommended supplement for both our dogs. Overall great experience and so grateful they are open on the weekends.

Just be warned they will take things to the most extreme worst case scenario to try and get you to pay insane test prices. Scarring someone and telling them the worst scenarios possible when there’s nothing to base it off of to get them to pay $367 for a respiratory panel is insane. Staff went to the extreme of telling me I should surrender my pet to the local animal shelter if I can’t afford their outrageous testing prices.
We have been taking our kitties since many years ago. They work Saturdays and Sundays, and are reasonable priced. The doctors and staff are great.

Not recommended, charged me too much and not even find out that my dog had inflammation on her spine but they said it was just a kidney infection and uti ..ends up it was a disease already when I decided to take it to doctor Madrigal. That's why my dog can't walked bcoz she was in pain.one of the staff made a comment that my dog was just lazy to walked.so if your furbaby are really sick don't take it there.

I am so glad I decided to take my dog here to get a second opinion on some issues she has been having for a while. I was treated with care and respect and offered legitimate solutions, unlike the vetco across the street. I was told that the expensive tests I paid for there came back with nothing and they couldn’t do anything. Meanwhile, as soon as I went into SD bay animal hospital, I was offered immediate solutions and the tests came back with real results. I wasted so much time and money prior and I am grateful to now know what’s going on and have a path forward thanks to this team! Overall a good experience, excluding the one girl with a bad attitude at the front desk.

I’m disappointed with my experience at San Diego Bay Hospital. They advertise a $25 first-visit exam, and when I called ahead, explained my dog’s symptoms, and asked if the promo still applied, I was told yes.

After the appointment, I was charged $98. When I called to ask why, they suddenly said the promo is “only for healthy pets.” But my friend brought her cat in for the same symptoms, got the $25 exam, and her cat actually tested positive for an infection — so that explanation doesn’t add up.

They also tried to push almost $400 in extra tests on me, which I declined — and thankfully I did, because my dog’s results came back completely normal.

The whole thing felt inconsistent and money-hungry. I wouldn’t recommend this place based on my experience.

Took my 2 year old pup here and the staff were great! Would highly recommend. Dr. Luecking was friendly and attentive and our RVT was also kind and informative! We came for a wellness exam and vaccine plus anal gland expression  and were in and out within 25 min. :)
Thank you for taking care of my sweet girl. She had masses removed and recovered well. Great service and such kind staff. Thank you again 😊. …
Really excellent service in re organizing appointment and care for my pit bull.
I was having car issues and told them I would be a few mins late, less than 10mins, they told me to reschedule because they have a lot of emergency today.

Editing to mention this is no longer the "best" vet we've visited. Unfortunately, over the years of bringing my dogs here, a lot has changed. All Vets that have seen my dog in the past years are no longer there, and the ones that are do not seem as compassionate and helpful as the previous ones have been. My dog is now 14, and spent half her years visiting this vet for care, but we were turned away yesterday during an emergency. This leaves owners with referrals to other vets when this was my vet! I'm disappointed that as my dog has gotten older and needed more care. Changing vets is a lot on her system when she's ill. Unfortunately the thousands I've spent at this veterinary hospital doesn't hold value, and they choose to overlook a senior pet after years of being a patient here. I've unfortunately chosen to move on. Thanks for your care thus far.
Peace ✌🏽

The best vet I've ever known. I love having a warm, honest, and transparent vet team to care for my babies. Caring for pets is an expense we all have to consider.
They offer the premium "I'll pay anything for my baby" estimate as well as the budget friendly one. I'm just gonna get more dogs so we can bring them here😂Muggs liked it here too.

We moved back to San Diego and decided to take our dogs back to San Diego Bay Animal Hospital because we had used them previously back in 2018/2019 and had a great experience. This time around I cannot say the same. It has been multiple issue with simple tasks such as prescriptions, vaccination statuses, and what should have been very easy conversations with the front desk that were not since we moved back in January. We will be taking our babies to another vet at their next annual exam.

They were ok with my first dog but after I went with my second dog a puppy, they started charging a cleaning fee. I asked what it was and it was because he used the restroom in the back while they were attending him…if y’all gonna charge 40 something dollars to pick up shit let me go back there and clean it. My aunt a vet technician and she says they should never be charging cleaning fees. After second time getting charged for cleaning fee I never went back. They clearly care about money
I took my dog yesterday and they were awesome as always.

Though we have not used their services yet, they went above and beyond checking with their veterinarian team to try to help us find our lost kitten. Thank you especially to Sarah for being such a great support. This level of care should probably translate to the care towards the animals.
Poor front desk service. I called for consultation about dog food and the lady told me "im not going to tell you what to feed your pet."
thank you very much service very good thank you

San Diego Bay Animal Hospital was quick to find a way to work my cat into their full schedule when time was of the essence in his care. They’re excellent about following up with test results. Rather than force treatments on me, they explain options and I make the choice with no pressure.

I have been bringing my Vizsla (now 4.5 to) to San Diego Bay Animal Hospital for about a year and a half. We always receive kind, caring, and thoughtful service, starting at the front desk. The office is clean and comfortable, parking is easy and plentiful, and the hours are convenient. 10/10 would recommend to anyone looking for vet care.

Huge thank you to SD Bay Animal Hospital!
You were the only place that took a serious look at our cat Simba when she was struggling with sudden swelling around her face. Your care and attention made all the difference. Simba is already feeling better, and we’re hopeful the swelling will fully go away soon.

Thank you so much again for caring for our little baby — we’re so grateful! 💛🐾

Easy to schedule and reschedule (if they get a cancelation). My most recent visit reminded me of why I chose this animal hospital in the first place: great service and patient staff. I have a very anxious dog.

Just FYI. During a dental extraction procedure, it was recommended that 5 teeth were extracted from my little girl. After the procedure she was left with only her fangs. Despite my concerns I was reassured that this was best practice and that cats do well without teeth. It was a one eighty turn after that. My happy go lucky type of cat, who was a bit of overweight until then, struggled with eating and appetite from then on until her recent passing. I spent a great amount of money to keep her alive afterwards and it was so worth it. She did put on a fight to remain by my side as long as she could and will be missed dearly.
They are great and very caring

I’m really sad to say I agree with the most recent reviews. I used to feel like the staff here genuinely cared about my dogs, but lately it seems like the focus is more on money than care. They’ve recommended unnecessary tests that lead to extra appointments and added charges, and now they won’t even provide standard medications that my allergy-prone pup has needed for years without making us jump through hoops. I’ll be taking both of my dogs to a new clinic. Giving 2 stars instead of 1 only because I truly used to love this place.

The doctor and staff were very compassionate during this heartbreaking loss to my family. This is how I want my Boy Boy to be remembered. He was born in  my dresser drawer in my apartment  he was the biggest of the litter. He was the sweetest, gentle cat . Brought lots of joy for 18 years to us all. We miss you and will never forget you.
BOY BOY R.I.P. 4/30/25
Till we unite again
They saved my dogs life on short notice and stayed open late to do the surgery, friendly staff and they give you what you need to know nicely without any beating around the bush.

Used to come here for any pet need. Now all they care about is money!! Running the most expensive tests possible, even when not necessary. Prices keep going up and the care quality is just going down! Sad to see what used to be a compassionate place to bring my pets turn into such a greedy place. It broke me when they wanted to charge for an exam fee before putting my 12 1/2 year old dog down while he had already had 11 seizures that morning. Needless to say we found a better more caring vet a couple miles down the road and won’t be stepping foot back into San Diego Bay.

I followed my previous vet to this place, Dr. Webb. She had great compassion for pets and their people. She would be really wonderful with prioritzing what needed to be done if you couldn't afford everything right away. Sadly, now that she is gone I tried 2 different doctors and was totally overwhelmed at the laundry list of things they wanted to do with both dogs. They said one of them had a heart mumur that has never shown up before and an estimate of $1000 to go to their cardiologist. My senior dog has been having seizures and I wanted to start limiting some, not all of her vaccinations. But they still were pushing for all of them.  They said they would get estimates of dental care for both dogs but then they never sent any further information. They "forgot" to remove the exam deposit that I paid in advance on the invoice until I pointed it out to them. They called back with other charges that they failed to put on a different invoice. I also kept getting texts "reminding me" for a test we had already done.

My older dog has the runs and I have done all the tests I can afford having just been there last month , but they wanted to do another senior blood panel when I just had one for her last month. These docs seem set on steering you towards the most expensive tests and diagnostics. When I expressed my frustration at just wanting some sort of medicine to help her stool, without all the expensive tests, I got a lecture about how caring for a pet is a financial responsibility. Like, really? They refused any more care unless I went with an MRI, or more expensive diagnostic. All of my experiences with them they want to play on your fear, and guilt you into the most costly treatments they can. I will not be returning.

I can’t say enough great things about Dr. Luecking and the entire team. From the moment we walked in, we were met with kindness and professionalism. Dr. Luecking took the time to thoroughly examine Po, explain everything in detail, and answer all my questions.

It’s clear that they genuinely care about the well-being of every animal they treat. (They even helped me collect a urine sample outside while I was there.) Po was handled with such compassion, and I felt more at ease when I was there. The clinic was also very clean! Just good vibes all around.

Thank you so much for fitting us in last minute!

If you’re looking for a knowledgeable, compassionate, and skilled veterinarian, I highly recommend Dr. Luecking!

I’m not sure what happened to this place.  We have been here a few times when we first moved to San Diego and we liked how they treated our senior dog and our new puppy.  After she passed we started bringing our senior Husky here due to having onset seizures at age 10 due to what was believed to be a brain tumor. We were assigned Dr. Webb,  she was the most compassionate doctors we ever had, we were so happy to have her as our Vet.

Fast forward 6 months (we had to come back every 6 months for blood work so our Husky could stay on his Phenobarbital) and we find out Dr. Webb moved,  it was a bummer but the front end staff was always so kind to us we decided to try a new Vet there.  And that’s when everything went sideways.

Even though we had a yearly exam done 6 months prior,  our new Vet said before they could do the blood panel we have to get a new exam so she could get familiar with our dog, even though we had one done with Dr. Webb, we just figured they would keep paper work so they have record but I guess not. At this point we had to get his medicine so we felt very forced to do this, so we agreed to the exam.  She maybe spent 5 mins with our dog, checked his heart beat and teeth and thats about it. Then she wants to do all these vaccines on our Husky and we try to avoid them due to the worry of it triggering our dogs seizures, he also wasn’t very active so we didn’t plan on taking him places he would be around other dogs anymore. When we asked if the vaccines would trigger a seizure we were assured that it wouldn’t.  Three hours later after leaving the vet, sure enough my Husky is having full grand mal seizures,  he was seizure free for 7 months prior to this point, pretty large coincidence.  We contacted the vet after he gets through his episodes and were told to up his medication dosage and that sometimes vaccines can trigger a seizure… What!? At this rate we are upset but just do what we are told.  Also the blood panel they tried to charge us for was almost double the cost the first time we went, we had to ask to get it down and compare it to our first visit bill,  which they eventually did. Worst part about all of this is the Doctor just seemed checked out and not compassionate at all.

Now another 6 months go by and we schedule a blood panel for end of March because they wouldn’t continue his medication unless we get it done,  the medication that has been keeping him alive and we were told if we take him off of it he will seizure. We get a quote and it’s more expensive than the previous time and this time wouldn’t be including the vaccines or exam.  I asked how exactly does a blood test go up that much in 6 months to be more expensive than all the things we had done the previous visit, I was told it was due to inflation. Sure… you bet.

Unfortunately we never could make it to this appointment due to our Husky having multiple seizures this morning. We knew his time was up, we have never seen him in this bad of shape. This is where the most heart breaking part of all this happens.  We called to set up an appointment for our dog to be euthanized today,  when we received a response from the Doctor,  we were told we had to pay for $155 exam first!  Are kidding me? I’ve lived with my dog the past year having seizures and you want me to get an exam first to make sure there isn’t something you can give him to keep him alive?  HE HAD 11 SEIZURES IN 5 HOURS!  He didn’t even have that many seizures in the past year combined. His quality of life was gone, he couldn’t walk, he had labored breathing, his eyes would not stop darting, he couldn’t get out of the postictal stage yet you want to give an exam?  I have never had a Vet tell me that they will make the hardest decision of owning a pet for me.

Luckily we found a Vet closer to us this evening that took us in,  completely understanding and compassionate as I ugly cried in front of all of them.  They also charged us $300 less for same services. Putting down a dog is extremely difficult but Dr. Allison Luecking made today even more difficult for us.

Today marks the last time I will ever step foot in San Diego Bay Animal Hospital. I’ve been bringing my dog here for six years, and we’ve had smooth visits for annual exams, vaccines, heartworm tests, biopsies, and anal gland extractions, all with professional and friendly vets who always commented on how calm my dog was. But today was a different story.

First, the vet confused my dog with another and started asking questions about epilepsy, even though my dog has never had epilepsy. Then, she claimed my dog had dislocated kneecaps, something no other vet had ever mentioned before. She also pushed for a Bordetella vaccine and general bloodwork, despite my clear requests not to perform them. The vet used the word "estimate" multiple times, making it feel more like a business meeting than a medical consultation, where the focus seemed to be solely on getting me to spend more money.

I explicitly stated that I only wanted an anal gland extraction if necessary, a nail trim, and a biopsy for a cyst. However, the vet insisted my dog needed Benadryl (an additional $80) before the biopsy, which seemed odd since my dog had undergone biopsies twice before without it. I also asked for tick and flea medication, which was priced at $36. When I mentioned it used to be $25, the vet associate informed me that prices had gone up since the beginning of the year. The final estimate for my visit ended up over $1,000, which included services I had specifically declined. I had to ask for those to be removed.

I also asked about insurance coverage for the biopsy, and the vet associate wrongly claimed it wouldn’t be covered because it was a pre-existing condition. After I corrected her, she admitted she didn’t know the answer.

Later, the vet associate returned with my dog, who looked anxious with red ears, and said she wouldn’t allow them to have her ears checked. She took my dog back, only to return shortly after, claiming my dog had bitten two staff members. I apologized and explained that my dog had never acted this way before. The vet then said they would only treat my dog if I gave her sedative pills at home prior the visit or allowed them to fully sedate her. I refused and asked for my dog to be brought back immediately.

When I went to leave, they tried charging me an additional $80 for the Benadryl, despite the biopsy never being done.

Throughout this entire experience, I felt like the only priority was making a profit, rather than my dog’s well-being. I won’t be coming back.

2 stars for the care only as the vet and staff were nice, and my dogs liked them. Minus stars for the deceitful prices. This place is well above other practices. The $25 wellness exam for new patients (one per household) offered on their website is actually $389.71 per dog. There are no line items to explain what is included and asking questions of the front desk staff is a exercise in futility. I really should have known better when this place required a deposit at appointment scheduling. Never in my 40 years of owning pets has a vet required a deposit BEFORE seeing the animal. What a waste of money. $414.71 for one dog. JFC what a ripoff.
Excellent staff. Friendly, knowledgeable, really loved on my dogs. Great care and experience.

On a full appt day, they were able to accommodate my small Maltese who desperately needed his anal glands released before the issue got more severe. They didn’t just stop there though. The vets & staff here made sure to adhere to any other concerns we had & they did. I didn’t realize my dog could have benefited from an allergy shot so that was offered & given to him as well. My heart is at ease now seeing him feel better. When my baby hurts, I hurt. So glad we came across this place, will for sure always consider them going forward if we ever have another urgent matter my dog needs attending to, especially on a Sunday when most vet offices are closed. Thank you so much SD bay animal staff!

I would give less than one star if I could. I took my dog to get spayed and the stitches were infected within 4 days. After I was instructed “to keep the bandage on, it will fall off” they then said the infection was my fault for keeping the bandage on. The bill to get the stitches cleaned was over $500, after the front desk said it would not cost anything. Overall this was a horrible experience and the stitches themselves looked questionable. I would not take your dog here.

This place is complete money grab ever since they sold to a corporation. That’s right, it’s no longer family owned, they sold their soul for profit. The service has gone down while the prices have gone WAY up. I took my dog in for a vaccine that she was due for, and two weeks later I got a text that she’s due for another. I asked why they couldn’t have done both at once and they said they didn’t know she needed both. Total oversight. A month later they tell me she’s due for her annual exam. I asked why the exam was necessary if she was just in for vaccines and had been seeing a specialist elsewhere. They couldn’t give me a good answer, just that it’s their policy. I didn’t take her for in for the unnecessary exam, and they withheld her prescription which THEY had deemed medically necessary for years. I asked for a few more pills to get her through the month and when I went to Von’s pharmacy to pick them up, the pharmacist told me the vet staff was extremely rude to him over the phone and told him to NEVER ask again to refill this prescription unless I go back to them for the exam. They don’t care about your pets, just your money!
The best vet ever

Both of my kitties have been well-taken care of by the lovely staff at San Diego Bay Animal Hospital since 2021. From their yearly check-ups, random concerns and sudden sicknesses… they are incredible at what they do and I feel great about putting my animals in their care!! 🫶🏼 …

I cannot say enough good things about the care my pets receive here. We switched from another local vet, and the care here has been significantly more accommodating for my dog with severe anxiety.

Dr. Lueking and Beckes have both gone out of their way to ensure my dog Maggie is as comfortable as possible when getting exams, treatment, and any procedure.

I also want to give a special shoutout to tech Erica, who worked with Maggie for a very specific issue over 3 different difficult appointments. By the time we were done, I almost cried I was so thankful for the special care Erica had given my pet.

One of my biggest regrets about having dogs was not coming here sooner; I can’t help but wonder if my pets would be less scared of the vet if I would have started here.

Thanks entire team for all that you do!
Communication is amazing, they call, text, email, send reminders.

Such a fantastic staff!! So kind, professional and thorough . whether its  a routine visit or an emergency injury, this is the best vet clinic we've ben too. Thank you for treating our animal family so well
Absolutely fantastic! I am so very happy we found SDBAH! The care and professionalism are above and beyond! Thank you!

I have been going to this vet for approximately 7 years. This place has not been the same for the last few years and I had considered leaving but hit my final straw. After my dogs sarcoma tumor came back and I was referred to a specialist …

Where do I even begin? SD Bay Animal Hospital is world class. They are incredibly kind, passionate, and professional.
